en: An old monochrome postcard view of a stone railway bridge with multiple arches spanning a river. A train track runs along the top of the bridge. In the background there is a small town with several houses and larger villa-like buildings, set against hilly, vine‑covered slopes and forested hills. Printed captions appear at the bottom of the image area and along the lower margin.
